verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a financial SaaS product like Kick, but the evidence pack never documents retention policies, data deletion, account or workspace deletion, or data purge controls. The related items (encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, period locks, the audit trail) cover access, integrity and security, not retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
